answers.core: It enhances a core node with rather basic functionality.
answers.workaround: It might be possible to write a script that sets `rect_min_size` to the desired value, but you need to calculate the width properly, taking styleboxes into account and text size etc. Also the text might change with a translation, so it just requires writing a bit of logic that already exists in the node.
